heroSection.heroSubtitle: From your first line of Python to ideas that change lives. Learn, build, and find your people in Pakistan’s Data Science Society.

siteSettings.siteDesc: A community for Pakistani students to learn data science, build meaningful projects, and grow together.

portal.loginDescription: Your people. Your projects. Your next possibility.
portal.studentDescription: Your space to learn, build and connect with students across Pakistan.
portal.ambassadorDescription: Lead your campus. Share opportunities. Help your community grow.

about.title:
Different beginnings.
One shared possibility.
about.desc: We believe your postcode should never decide your potential. DSS connects curious students across Pakistan through data, ideas, and the simple act of learning together.

research.title:
Good questions.
New perspectives.
research.desc: Read, question, and explore the work behind the models. A space for research papers, thoughtful experiments, and shared discoveries.

projects.title:
Less just watching.
More actually building.
projects.desc: Explore open projects from our community. Read the code, try an idea, and take your next step from learning to making.

events.title:
Step away from the tabs.
Come meet your people.
events.desc: Practical workshops, shared challenges, and conversations that stay with you. Discover what’s happening in the society.

resources.title:
Your next breakthrough
starts with a little learning.
resources.desc: Handbooks, notebooks, reading lists, and tools for your data science journey. Start where you are. Build from there.

blog.title:
Ideas worth sharing.
Stories worth reading.
blog.desc: Notes from the learning process. Explore community perspectives on data science, research, and building things that matter.

community.title:
Your campus is a beginning.
Your community is bigger.
community.desc: Connect with students across Pakistan. Share what you know, ask what you don’t, and make room for someone else to grow.

join.title:
There’s a place
for your curiosity.
join.desc: Create a student account, apply for society membership, or take the next step as a campus ambassador. You don’t have to know it all to begin.

contact.title:
A conversation can
start something good.
contact.desc: A question, a collaboration, or an idea for your campus? We’d love to hear from you. Your message goes directly to the society team.
